part.text:
The robot is now close to the red ball and has gone into its rest crouch. The ball is on the floor a short distance ahead, a little to the right of center in the last bottom-camera image.

I didn't turn to face it exactly, and the final image was taken after the crouch, so the robot may not be pointed straight at the ball. Before resting, I stepped forward and a foot bumper tripped. That probably means the foot touched the ball. The motors are now off.
